about: Reference sun and moon values for tests/test_astro.py, every row from the US Naval Observatory's 'Complete Sun and Moon Data for One Day' page, fetched by the controller on 2026-11-17 after the user approved the fetch. Local wall-clock times (24 h) as the page printed them, which are the times a phone in the row's time zone shows (on 2026-11-01 the page's times are EST after the 2 a.m. change; on 2026-03-08 EDT). null means USNO lists no such event that local day ('none listed', or the object stays above or below the horizon or twilight limit). Record: docs/content-review.md, 'Daylight and moon reference values'.
